annotation.notes: Q: 'What transparency obligations apply under Article 50?' NOTE: Article 50 is CONDITIONAL_ON risk:limited, NOT high-risk — transparency is a separate layer for limited-risk systems. Mixed roles (provider/deployer). Required core: OBL-DISCLOSE-AI (summary: inform people they interact with AI + mark synthetic content, [provider,deployer]) and OBL-ART50-1 (chatbots must disclose they are AI, [provider]) — the two most basic transparency duties, each CONDITIONAL_ON risk:limited. Supporting: 50-2 (watermark synthetic content), 50-3 (emotion/biometric), 50-4A (deepfakes — famous but a specific case, not core), 50-4B (AI text on public-interest matters), 50-5 (manner/timing of disclosure). Excluded: 50-7 (AI Office codes of practice, role [], administrative).
